notes:
K8Secret 0.6.4 — a new icon, and the rail tells the truth.

The app icon is the mark itself — three nodes around a lit core, with no rounded-square plate behind it — rendered from the same view the launch animation assembles, so the icon and the app cannot drift apart.

The rail's counts only ever described lists you had already opened: they filled in as you wandered and emptied again whenever you changed namespace. Every type is counted for the current scope now, and zero is shown rather than hidden.

Several screens moved closer to the design they were drawn from. Services and secrets are three-column lists under a header rather than two-line cards. Pods use a single status dot instead of system symbols beside a pill that already said the same thing. A secret's keys are one line each — key, value, actions — with borderless controls that appear when you point at them. The YAML editor wears the same canvas as everything else. Restarting a deployment and deleting a pod now ask in the app's own dialog rather than a system alert. And the window drops its pale frame for a proper shadow.
